feeds.title: A Closer Listen
feeds.description: A home for instrumental and experimental music. Since 2012, A Closer Listen has claimed a specialized niche in the music industry: instrumental album reviews. By concentrating on this above all else (singles, videos, concerts, interviews, lyric albums, announcements), we've built a healthy fanbase and a strong reputation.

feeds.title: Faeton Music » Experimental Electronic
feeds.description: Discover uncharted, ambient-sounding Experimental Electronic music tracks and artists sourced by Faeton Music. Faeton Music is a music reviews and discovery website that aims to find and share some of the freshest, soothing alternative music deserving to be heard.

feeds.title: Frequency State
feeds.description: Explore the uncharted territories of the electronic music landscape, where innovation thrives and sonic boundaries are pushed. The Electronica blog is a platform to showcase the diverse and avant-garde sounds that define the underground electronic scene and to foster a community of like-minded individuals who share a love for sonic exploration.

feeds.title: New Music Buff » Experimental Music
feeds.description: Indulge perspectives from an informed new music fan. Enjoy nuanced takes and some amusing anecdotes from artists of Experimental Music. New Music Buff envisages the musical interest and preferences of a long-time listener with a fervent interest in all music new and old.

feeds.title: Record Crates United » Experimental Music
feeds.description: Discover experimental music tracks that touch the soul and spark newer musical frontiers. Keith Hadad's Record Crates United is a home for wayward music. Modern and classic underground and independent sounds of an eclectic nature are celebrated here.

feeds.title: Onyx Music Reviews » Experimental
feeds.description: Browse the latest posts tagged Experimental Music. Onyx Music Reviews endeavors to cover dark alternative music that often flies under the radar. whether well-established or up-and-coming. Genres include gothic, post-punk, deathrock, darkwave, coldwave, new wave, synth, EBM, industrial, and some metal.

feeds.title: MySoundposter » Experimental
feeds.description: Explore touching stories and musical journeys involving experimental music. Started as a side project of the New York-based Soundposter Inc, mySoundposter.blog is run by Urs Lerch, a computer scientist and amateur musician with the mission to support independent artists to be heard and seen.

feeds.title: Jazz Right Now
feeds.description: Enter a new era of resounding Jazz across the globe. Jazz Right Now is a commentary on New York City's contemporary creative improvised music scene. You will find here the latest news on the scene as well as an archive of musicians, recordings, interviews, concerts, reviews, and other information.

feeds.title: Noise Not Music
feeds.description: Welcome to Noise Not Music. Here you'll find reviews of recent albums, various features and lists, and occasional mixes. I tend to focus on material that resides in the experimental or avant-garde realm of music, but nothing is off-limits.

feeds.title: Jeff Bagato » Experimental Music
feeds.description: Discover Jeff Bagato's musings and exploration of Experimental Music. Read poems, glitch videos, and other academic writings. A multi-media artist living near San Antonio, TX, Jeff Bagato produces poetry and prose as well as electronic music, glitch videos, sticker art, and pop surrealism paintings.

feeds.title: Song Bar
feeds.description: Song-bar.com was set up in February 2016 by The Landlord, pseudonym for a known professional culture and features writer from The Guardian, The Observer and other publications. The Song Bar is a non-profit website promoting good music. It's a virtual venue for enthusiasts and specialists to share in their joy and knowledge, and engage in friendly banter, not only about songs but a variety of other subjects from film to food, animals to Absinthe.

feeds.title: The Wire
feeds.description: The online face of the world's greatest independent music magazine was established in 1982. The magazine features News, updates, audio, video, shopping options, and many things related to the music industry.

feeds.title: Faeton Music » Experimental Electronic
feeds.description: Discover uncharted, ambient-sounding Experimental Electronic music tracks and artists sourced by Faeton Music. Faeton Music is a music reviews and discovery website that aims to find and share some of the freshest, soothing alternative music deserving to be heard.

feeds.title: Experimental Melbourne
feeds.description: The who, what, when and where of experimental music in Melbourne, Australia.

feeds.title: Cyclic Defrost
feeds.description: Cyclic Defrost is an online magazine that covers. Interesting music. Whether its independent electronic music, avant-rock, experimental sound art, leftfield hip hop and everything in between that's fine. If it's weird and wonderful, strange and new you will find it here. We have no interest in fashion spreads, alcohol or clothing advertising, nor do we accept advertising in the guise of 'editorial'. We hope you feel the same way.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Experimental Music
feeds.description: Latest news and features covering the Experimental Music from theguardian.com, the world's leading liberal voice. Catch artist interviews, track reviews, and other updates. The Guardian is one of the world's leading English-language newspaper websites renowned for its agenda-setting journalism.

feeds.title: Louder Than War » Experimental Music News
feeds.description: Read The Latest Experimental Music News From The Writers & Contributors at Louder Than War - The Home of Music and Culture. Dive into a splurge of Punk, Metal, and Rock Music Live Reviews and interviews to stay up-to-date.

feeds.title: Dereks Music Blog » Experimental
feeds.description: Explore the frontier of Experimental Music artistry with synth sounds and deeply insightful narration. Dereks Music Blog delves deep into the world and history of experimental music, spotlighting boundary-pushing artists and mind-bending sonic landscapes.

feeds.title: Dungeon Synth & Dark Ambient Reviews » Experimental
feeds.description: Dive deep into the heart of avant-garde musical experimentation with insightful, enlightening reviews and artist interviews. Explore the Dungeon Synth & Dark Ambient Reviews blog catering to all Dungeon Synth lovers.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound » Experimental
feeds.description: Delivering uniquely atmospheric sound experiences, Obscure Sound presents a curated collection of chillingly dark and emotive Experimental music from lesser-known bands. Obscure Sound is an indie music site featuring quality music, preferably from smaller artists. It also shares album features, interviews, and playlists.

feeds.title: Independent Music Promotions » Experimental
feeds.description: Follow the latest headlines and artist events in the Experimental Rock genre. Discover featured music and selected albums for your experimental taste. Independent Music Promotions is a highly respected music PR and music marketing company that represents an international roster of 'musicians with depth' from a broad spectrum of musical genres.

feeds.title: One Track At A Time
feeds.description: Follow My Blog Get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: ATTN:Magazine
feeds.description: ATTN: Magazine is an exploration of new experimental music and sound art, founded on a love for the failures and contradictions in articulating the experience of listening. ATTN is run by Jack Chuter (they/them) from Bournemouth, England: writer, intermittent musician and author of Storm Static Sleep: A Pathway Through Post-Rock.
